title: Alliance Games 2025
summary: EUNICE Alliance Games 2025 brought students to Viseu, Portugal, for five days of volleyball, basketball and cultural activities, fostering teamwork, friendship, intercultural exchange and European spirit.
details: The Games ran from 10 to 14 November 2025, the first edition hosted in Viseu. They opened with a parade of the teams and closed with the symbolic handover of the torch to the University of Cantabria, host of the next edition.

title: Alliance Games 2024
summary: More than 80 EUNICE students met in Valenciennes for mixed volleyball and basketball tournaments, cultural activities and international exchange.

title: E-Chess Tournament – Alliance Games 2023
summary: An online Swiss-format chess tournament for students and staff from EUNICE partner universities, fostering friendly competition and intercultural exchange.

title: Virtual Escape Room – Code Europa: The Disruptor Dilemma
summary: A virtual escape room where players protected Europe by solving puzzles while learning about EU institutions, democratic participation and European challenges.

title: EUNICE Week
summary: A Europe-wide EUNICE festival bringing students and university communities together through cultural, academic and nursing activities. It fostered European identity.
